note: T3.3 kernel trial (18 Oct 2026): a 1600 ID x 12 shell (body `Vessel S1`), a 6 in opening cut at the neck OD (168.3, radial at z 1500), then a neck tube of the same OD trimmed to the shell's inside radius (800) and joined with solid.combine. The opening cut removes 236,946 mm³ where 267,347 are expected (−11 %, within the tessellated measure's error on the whole shell); the join then runs 207 s and fails ('boolean Union: the operation failed: no result'): the neck's outside and the hole's wall are the same cylinder. Fallback in triya-vessel::nozzle::plan: no opening is cut; a solid rod is joined from a plane inside the wall (or trimmed by the mid-wall surface) and the bore is cut afterwards, which is accurate (+0.44 % added, −0.02 % bored) and takes 5–30 s.
